description: Rb₂NaNdCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NdCl₆ octahedra. All Rb-Cl bond lengths are 3.88 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.77 Å. Nd is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NdCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nd-Cl bond lengths are 2.73 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Nd atom.
